spis.first_use.adopt_corpus.body: Dooro galka kaydkaaga. Isticmaalka koowaad wuxuu dhammaadaa oo keliya marka Spis core aqbalo oo keydiyo goobta oo app-ku ka akhriyo kaataloog. Qaadashada soo noqnoqota waxay tixraacyada u muujisaa kuwo aan isbeddelin halkii ay laba jibbaari lahayd.
spis.first_use.adopt_corpus.title: Dooro kaydkaaga jira
spis.first_use.promise.body: Spis wuxuu ka bilaabmaa kayd caddeyn ah oo aad hore u maamuli jirtay. Wuxuu akhriyaa faylasha asalka ah ee kaatalooga, tixraacyada, asalka, sawirrada shaashadda, duubista iyo rasiidhada meeshooda, halkii uu koobiyeyn lahaa ururin la yareeyay.
spis.first_use.promise.title: Ka bilow kaydkaaga tixraaca ee jira
spis.first_use.read_and_write.body: Dooro gal la furay oo ka kooban example-catalogs.json caadiga ah, sources.json iyo references.json ee kaataloog kasta, iyo dhammaan faylasha diiwaanka ee la tixraacay. Spis wuxuu hubiyaa garaafka oo dhan ka hor inta uusan keydin waddada. Kaydadka waa la diidaa si aan fayl ama goob asal ah si aamusnaan ah looga tegin.
spis.first_use.read_and_write.title: Qaado hal kayd oo dhammaystiran oo la baari karo
walkthrough.fallback.body: Raac tallaabadan si aad u gaarto kaatalooga koowaad ee Spis ka warbixin karo.
walkthrough.fallback.title: Sii wad dejinta Spis
walkthrough.row.detail: Eeg hagitaanka alaabtan ay muujiso isticmaalka koowaad.
walkthrough.row.title: Hagitaanka isticmaalka koowaad
walkthrough.tagline: Xaaladda la cabbiray ee kaydka, hal daaqad
walkthrough.unavailable.body: Hagitaanka la socday lama akhrin karin. Waxba lagama beddelin kaydka.
walkthrough.unavailable.title: Hagitaanka isticmaalka koowaad lama heli karo
